scope: V1 request admission, RequestStatus, progress fields, preemption, output processing, abort and cleanup.

claims.claim: The current V1 RequestStatus enum includes waiting states for structured-output grammar, remote KV transfer and streaming sessions, plus RUNNING, PREEMPTED and multiple terminal finish states.
claims.notes: These are implementation-level statuses and not every request passes through every state.

claims.claim: V1 Request tracks num_computed_tokens, num_in_flight_tokens, output placeholders, prefill-chunk state and preemption counts to coordinate scheduling and asynchronous execution.
claims.notes: Progress may be optimistically advanced at scheduling time and reconciled when outputs return.

claims.claim: Preemption frees request KV blocks, sets status to PREEMPTED, resets num_computed_tokens, increments preemption count and prepends the request to the waiting queue.
claims.notes: PREEMPTED is resumable and not a terminal state.

claims.claim: V1 OutputProcessor consumes EngineCoreOutputs, updates request statistics, detokenizes token IDs, applies stop checks, constructs RequestOutput and sends it to a streaming queue or synchronous caller.
claims.notes: Some requests use pooling outputs rather than text detokenization.

claims.claim: EngineCore handles ABORT messages by invoking abort_requests; Scheduler.finish_requests removes the request from queues, sets a terminal status and frees request resources.
claims.notes: In-flight model execution and asynchronous KV transfer can delay some cleanup.

claims.claim: Scheduler request cleanup can delay KV block freeing when connectors report pending transfers or other asynchronous work.
claims.notes: Client-visible completion and physical cache reuse need not be simultaneous in every connector path.
